WITH status_totals AS (
  SELECT
    si.healtheval,
    SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scancount,
    SUM(sc.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS gb_per_minute
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS si
    ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY si.healtheval
),
status_rates AS (
  SELECT
    healtheval,
    total_scancount,
    gb_per_minute,
    AVG(gb_per_minute) OVER () AS average_rate
  FROM status_totals
)
SELECT
  healtheval,
  total_scancount,
  gb_per_minute,
  gb_per_minute - average_rate AS rate_above_average
FROM status_rates
WHERE gb_per_minute > average_rate;
